title: Research: managed memory services for agents (Claude memory tool, Foundry agent memory, Cloudflare Agents state)
goal: How does the Claude API memory tool store and read memory files, with the storage held by whom? What does Microsoft Foundry Agent Service offer for agent memory, at what release status? How do Cloudflare Agents and Durable Objects keep one agent's state consistent across requests and clients?
